mapper.sql: id, hotel_id, supplier_room_type_code, room_type_name, max_occupancy, active, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_type_mapping (hotel_id, supplier_room_type_code, room_type_name, max_occupancy, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{hotelId}, #{supplierRoomTypeCode}, #{roomTypeName}, #{maxOccupancy}, TRUE, NOW(), NOW()) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), room_type_name = new.room_type_name, max_occupancy = new.max_occupancy, active = TRUE, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM room_type_mapping WHERE hotel_id = #{hotelId} AND active = TRUE ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM room_type_mapping WHERE active = TRUE ORDER BY id
